lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: First one's by hand. I'll talk you through it.
lines.spoken_text: First one's by hand. I'll talk you through it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pistol first. Lay it on the black mat, flat.
lines.spoken_text: Pistol first. Lay it on the black mat, flat.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Your tool roll. Undo the strap, then roll it out.
lines.spoken_text: Your tool roll. Undo the strap, then roll it out.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Servo, both alloy sheets and the vial. Into the tray.
lines.spoken_text: Servo, both alloy sheets and the vial. Into the tray.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Vial's round. Set it down gentle or it rolls.
lines.spoken_text: Vial's round. Set it down gentle or it rolls.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: It rolled. Pick it up and try again, slower.
lines.spoken_text: It rolled. Pick it up and try again, slower.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pistol up. Three pulses at the card. See how it walks.
lines.spoken_text: Pistol up. Three pulses at the card. See how it walks.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Give it a shake if you like. Hear that rattle.
lines.spoken_text: Give it a shake if you like. Hear that rattle.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Cell out before anything else. Thumb the latch, then pull.
lines.spoken_text: Cell out before anything else. Thumb the latch, then pull.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Take it and carry it over. Square it up and it drops in.
lines.spoken_text: Take it and carry it over. Square it up and it drops in.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hold on it and circle the mouse slow. Feel it bite.
lines.spoken_text: Hold on it and circle the mouse slow. Feel it bite.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hold it on the card. It wanders. Fire when it's on.
lines.spoken_text: Hold it on the card. It wanders. Fire when it's on.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Tool on the mark, then click. Just the mark.
lines.spoken_text: Tool on the mark, then click. Just the mark.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hold it and shake the mouse. Short and sharp.
lines.spoken_text: Hold it and shake the mouse. Short and sharp.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hold and follow the line. Steady pace, don't rush it.
lines.spoken_text: Hold and follow the line. Steady pace, don't rush it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hold to lift, let go to strike. Higher hits harder.
lines.spoken_text: Hold to lift, let go to strike. Higher hits harder.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hold it down and listen. Let go when it sounds right.
lines.spoken_text: Hold it down and listen. Let go when it sounds right.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hold and scrub over it. Keep going till it's bright.
lines.spoken_text: Hold and scrub over it. Keep going till it's bright.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Something's still holding it. Free that first.
lines.spoken_text: Something's still holding it. Free that first.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Not that one yet. Look for what's lit.
lines.spoken_text: Not that one yet. Look for what's lit.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: You'll want a tool for that.
lines.spoken_text: You'll want a tool for that.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Wrong tool for that. Put it back.
lines.spoken_text: Wrong tool for that. Put it back.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Frame in the vise. Snug, not tight, or you'll mark it.
lines.spoken_text: Frame in the vise. Snug, not tight, or you'll mark it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Cutters. Snip both wire twists on the old grip.
lines.spoken_text: Cutters. Snip both wire twists on the old grip.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Peel the tape off. Find the loose end and follow it round.
lines.spoken_text: Peel the tape off. Find the loose end and follow it round.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Upper screw first. Slotted bit in the driver.
lines.spoken_text: Upper screw first. Slotted bit in the driver.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Screws go in the dish. Lose one and you're making another.
lines.spoken_text: Screws go in the dish. Lose one and you're making another.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Oil on the lower screw first. One drop. Let it soak.
lines.spoken_text: Oil on the lower screw first. One drop. Let it soak.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Now tap the driver's head. Two taps. Wakes the thread up.
lines.spoken_text: Now tap the driver's head. Two taps. Wakes the thread up.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Slot's gone round. Pliers on the head, back it out slow.
lines.spoken_text: Slot's gone round. Pliers on the head, back it out slow.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Screws are out. Lift both scales off, onto the mat.
lines.spoken_text: Screws are out. Lift both scales off, onto the mat.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Trigger lead. Pinch the tab, not the wire.
lines.spoken_text: Trigger lead. Pinch the tab, not the wire.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Punch on the pin, then the mallet. Three firm taps.
lines.spoken_text: Punch on the pin, then the mallet. Three firm taps.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pliers now. Pull it the rest of the way.
lines.spoken_text: Pliers now. Pull it the rest of the way.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Bent it. On the vise, tap it straight.
lines.spoken_text: Bent it. On the vise, tap it straight.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Slide the housing off. Thumb on that spring, it jumps.
lines.spoken_text: Slide the housing off. Thumb on that spring, it jumps.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Turn the frame round in the vise. Look at the tang.
lines.spoken_text: Turn the frame round in the vise. Look at the tang.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Frame to the stand. Servo in the vise.
lines.spoken_text: Frame to the stand. Servo in the vise.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Brush it. The screws are under that muck.
lines.spoken_text: Brush it. The screws are under that muck.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Case screws. Cross bit this time.
lines.spoken_text: Case screws. Cross bit this time.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: That one's chewed. Squeeze the pliers first, then turn.
lines.spoken_text: That one's chewed. Squeeze the pliers first, then turn.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pick in the seam. Three clips. Lean, don't stab.
lines.spoken_text: Pick in the seam. Three clips. Lean, don't stab.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Snip the leads at the board end. On the bands.
lines.spoken_text: Snip the leads at the board end. On the bands.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Burnt board out. Keep its resistor, bin the rest.
lines.spoken_text: Burnt board out. Keep its resistor, bin the rest.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Circlip next. Pliers. Keep hold or it flies.
lines.spoken_text: Circlip next. Pliers. Keep hold or it flies.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Gears off. Top one first.
lines.spoken_text: Gears off. Top one first.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Two small screws, then lift the gimbal. That's the prize.
lines.spoken_text: Two small screws, then lift the gimbal. That's the prize.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Wind the copper onto the bobbin. Steady, it snaps.
lines.spoken_text: Wind the copper onto the bobbin. Steady, it snaps.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Gimbal in the jar. Swirl it.
lines.spoken_text: Gimbal in the jar. Swirl it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Brush the race and both trunnions. Bright metal.
lines.spoken_text: Brush the race and both trunnions. Bright metal.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pick the grit out. Three little holes.
lines.spoken_text: Pick the grit out. Three little holes.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: One drop on each trunnion. One.
lines.spoken_text: One drop on each trunnion. One.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Flick the rotor. Listen to it.
lines.spoken_text: Flick the rotor. Listen to it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Trim the leads at the marks. Sense lead, flush.
lines.spoken_text: Trim the leads at the marks. Sense lead, flush.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Frayed lead. Strip it back and twist it tidy.
lines.spoken_text: Frayed lead. Strip it back and twist it tidy.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Strippers. Squeeze, then pull. Don't bite the copper.
lines.spoken_text: Strippers. Squeeze, then pull. Don't bite the copper.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Iron and solder. Tin the ends till they shine.
lines.spoken_text: Iron and solder. Tin the ends till they shine.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Leads in the clip. Solder across the resistor, then shrink.
lines.spoken_text: Leads in the clip. Solder across the resistor, then shrink.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Short lead. Splice a bit on. One more joint.
lines.spoken_text: Short lead. Splice a bit on. One more joint.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Probes across the resistor. Lamp should light.
lines.spoken_text: Probes across the resistor. Lamp should light.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Old scale on the sheet. Scribe round it.
lines.spoken_text: Old scale on the sheet. Scribe round it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Clamp both sheets. Snips, cut on the line.
lines.spoken_text: Clamp both sheets. Snips, cut on the line.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Strip off the edge first. That's your strap.
lines.spoken_text: Strip off the edge first. That's your strap.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: File to the line. Long strokes. Stop at the line.
lines.spoken_text: File to the line. Long strokes. Stop at the line.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Template back on. Punch each hole mark.
lines.spoken_text: Template back on. Punch each hole mark.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Four holes. Let the bit cut, don't lean on it.
lines.spoken_text: Four holes. Let the bit cut, don't lean on it.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Strap in the vise. Bend it to the mark. Twice.
lines.spoken_text: Strap in the vise. Bend it to the mark. Twice.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Cracked. Spare strip's on the mat. Same again.
lines.spoken_text: Cracked. Spare strip's on the mat. Same again.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Tang mould from the rack. Seat it, brush it out.
lines.spoken_text: Tang mould from the rack. Seat it, brush it out.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Offcuts in, then pour the nanites to the line.
lines.spoken_text: Offcuts in, then pour the nanites to the line.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Close and lock it. Pump, then hold.
lines.spoken_text: Close and lock it. Pump, then hold.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Vent it first. Pliers, it's hot. Then quench.
lines.spoken_text: Vent it first. Pliers, it's hot. Then quench.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Knock the sprue off. File the flash. Ease the pocket.
lines.spoken_text: Knock the sprue off. File the flash. Ease the pocket.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Rotor out, then press the gimbal home. Stop at flush.
lines.spoken_text: Rotor out, then press the gimbal home. Stop at flush.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Cracked the lug. Bead of nanites on it, it'll hold.
lines.spoken_text: Cracked the lug. Bead of nanites on it, it'll hold.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Tuck the loop in the side channel. Into the clips.
lines.spoken_text: Tuck the loop in the side channel. Into the clips.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Rotor back in. Ring on, snap it home.
lines.spoken_text: Rotor back in. Ring on, snap it home.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Strap over the spine. It clicks.
lines.spoken_text: Strap over the spine. It clicks.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Plates on their pegs. Left, turn it over, right.
lines.spoken_text: Plates on their pegs. Left, turn it over, right.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Start the screws by hand. Feel them catch.
lines.spoken_text: Start the screws by hand. Feel them catch.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Drive them home, then torque. Stop when it pitches up.
lines.spoken_text: Drive them home, then torque. Stop when it pitches up.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Applicator along both seams. Steady.
lines.spoken_text: Applicator along both seams. Steady.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Lamp over. Ten seconds. Leave it be.
lines.spoken_text: Lamp over. Ten seconds. Leave it be.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Tilt it hard. It should swing once and stop.
lines.spoken_text: Tilt it hard. It should swing once and stop.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Lead's pinched. Ease it back along its channel.
lines.spoken_text: Lead's pinched. Ease it back along its channel.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Frame back in the vise. Grip up onto the tang.
lines.spoken_text: Frame back in the vise. Grip up onto the tang.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Lead down the back channel. Plug it, right way up.
lines.spoken_text: Lead down the back channel. Plug it, right way up.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pin back in. Two taps.
lines.spoken_text: Pin back in. Two taps.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Pin's proud. Tap it flush.
lines.spoken_text: Pin's proud. Tap it flush.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: New screws from the dish. Cross bit.
lines.spoken_text: New screws from the dish. Cross bit.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Old bits in the bin. Pistol on the mat. Cell in.
lines.spoken_text: Old bits in the bin. Pistol on the mat. Cell in.
